handoff.text:
Redesign notes: where we left off (14 Nov 2026)

Direction
• Position: theoretical physics + HPC + quantum computing, not tied to specific papers or projects.
• Sections match the current site, but with Experience before Education: About, Experience, Education, Teaching & Outreach, Publications, with the full content of each page. Each keeps its quote (Feynman, Galilei, Einstein, Landau, Poincaré); Newton stays in the footer. No news section.
• Hero scenes, fitted to the visible part of the screen: a binary black hole on curved spacetime that spirals in, merges and rings down (gravitational waves, lensed stars, a strain readout); a compute cluster (racks, switches, data packets); and the 5-qubit quantum Fourier transform, ending in measurements.
• Backdrop: a starfield with a soft glow in the current field's colour; dot-grid paper in light mode.
• Profile picture (the GitHub 'pic with code') beside the name in the hero. Its background may be changed later.
• The About text is the user's own wording (Nov 2026); keep it as written.
• No mention of Munich or Germany, and no 'engineer' label in headlines.
• Colours: physics amber, HPC teal, quantum violet. Dark by default, with a light toggle.
• The final site stays on GitHub Pages + Jekyll: no build step, plain JavaScript.

Still to do
• Rewrite the remaining draft copy (headlines, contact line).
• Check which field(s) each paper is tagged with.
• Then port to the real site: papers, talks and news as data files, and a new layout replacing the old HTML5 UP template.
